properties.name: Concave collision masks
properties.description: Manual test for concave sprite collision masks (automatically split into convex polygons).

events.comment:
Manual test for concave sprite collision masks.
ConcaveShape has a concave (L shaped) collision mask, split into convex polygons by the game engine.
ConvexShape has a convex (hexagon) mask. FullImageShape has no custom mask (full image bounding box).
Move the Player with the arrow keys: it must be blocked by the shapes, and enter the empty corner of the L.

events.name: Player is blocked by the shapes
Collect the coin hidden in the empty corner of the L

events.comment:
The player has no keyboard controls here: the NavMesh pathfinding drives it to the nearest coin, one after the other, until the 4 coins are collected.
The shapes are NavMesh obstacles: the concave L must leave its empty corner walkable.

tests.description: The concave L mask must let the player stand in its empty corner and collect the coin there, while blocking it on its edges. Positions are relative to the L instance so the scene layout can change.
tests.name: ConcaveMaskBlocksPlayer
source: // ConcaveShape is a 256x256 "L" with 80px thick arms: its empty corner covers
"The coin must be placed inside the empty corner of the L");
// 1. The empty corner of the L is not solid: a player standing there is not pushed away.
"Player in the empty corner of the L must not be pushed away, got " + inCorner.x + "," + inCorner.y);
// 2. Walking right towards the top arm, the player is blocked by the left edge of the L.
harness.assert(blocked.x + blocked.width <= lShape.x + 0.5, "Player must be blocked by the L left edge, right side at " + (blocked.x + blocked.width) + " for edge at " + lShape.x);
harness.assert(blocked.x + blocked.width > lShape.x - 10, "Player should have reached the L, right side at " + (blocked.x + blocked.width));
// 3. Walking up inside the empty corner, aligned with the coin: the coin is collected,
// then the player is blocked by the inner edge of the L (y = l.y + 80).
harness.assert(inner.y >= lShape.y + 80 - 0.5, "Player must be blocked by the inner edge of the L, top at " + inner.y + " for edge at " + (lShape.y + 80));
harness.assert(inner.y < lShape.y + 140, "Player should have moved up to the inner edge, top at " + inner.y);

tests.description: In Scene2, the NavMesh pathfinding must drive the player to the 4 coins, including the ones only reachable through the empty corners of the concave L shapes.
